## Synopsis

```text
perch mail caps [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Connect to the configured submission server, perform EHLO, and print the advertised extensions. No message is sent and no credentials are used.

Aliases: `capabilities`.

## Notes

- The local perch relay advertises PIPELINING, 8BITMIME, ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES, SIZE, SMTPUTF8, STARTTLS, and AUTH on loopback or TLS.
- It does not expose DSN, CHUNKING, BINARYMIME, REQUIRETLS, or DELIVERBY.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--username, -u <value>` | account username (env PERCH_IMAP_USER) |
| `--password <value>` | account password (prefer PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD or --password-file) |
| `--password-file <value>` | read the account password from a file |
| `--password-stdin` | read the account password from stdin |
| `--timeout <value>` | connection timeout (default: 30s) |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--smtp-server, -S <value>` | SMTP submission server (smtps://host, smtp://host, or host[:port]); defaults from --config |
| `--smtp-plaintext` | connect to SMTP without TLS (use only on trusted networks) |
| `--smtp-starttls` | require STARTTLS for SMTP |
| `--smtp-implicit-tls` | use implicit TLS for SMTP (usually port 465) |
| `--smtp-insecure` | skip SMTP TLS certificate verification |
| `--smtp-ca-file <value>` | PEM CA bundle used to verify the SMTP server certificate |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch mail caps

perch mail caps --smtp-server smtp.mxraven.email:587
```
